tasks.label: Verify patient history
tasks.command: $runtime = Get-ChildItem "$env:TEMP\dermiassist-node-runtime" -Filter node.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; & $runtime --version; & $runtime --test --test-name-pattern='patient history' tests/production-regressions.test.cjs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $runtime node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --incremental false; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Verify patient history database
tasks.command:
$runtime = Get-ChildItem "$env:TEMP\dermiassist-node-runtime" -Filter node.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; $env:Path = "$(Split-Path $runtime);$env:Path"; & $runtime "$(Split-Path $runtime)
ode_modules
pm in
pm-cli.js" install --save-dev --ignore-scripts --package-lock=false --no-audit --no-fund @electric-sql/pglite; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $runtime --test --test-name-pattern='patient history' tests/production-regressions.test.cjs; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Test patient history PostgreSQL rules
tasks.command: $runtimeFolder = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'dermiassist-node-runtime'; $runtime = Get-ChildItem $runtimeFolder -Filter node.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; $runtimeRoot = Split-Path $runtime; $env:Path = $runtimeRoot + ';' + $env:Path; $npm = Join-Path $runtimeRoot 'node_modules\npm\bin\npm-cli.js'; & $runtime $npm install --save-dev --ignore-scripts --package-lock=false --no-audit --no-fund @electric-sql/pglite; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $runtime --test --test-name-pattern='patient history' tests/production-regressions.test.cjs; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Run isolated history database regression
tasks.command: $runtimeFolder = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'dermiassist-node-runtime'; $runtime = Get-ChildItem $runtimeFolder -Filter node.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'node.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*npm-cli.js*install --save-dev*electric-sql/pglite*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; $npm = Join-Path (Split-Path $runtime) 'node_modules\npm\bin\npm-cli.js'; $prefix = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'dermiassist-history-test-deps'; & $runtime $npm install --prefix $prefix --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --fetch-retries=0 --fetch-timeout=30000 @electric-sql/pglite@0.3.15; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $env:NODE_PATH = Join-Path $prefix 'node_modules'; & $runtime --test --test-name-pattern='patient history' tests/production-regressions.test.cjs; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Check history permissions
tasks.command: $runtimeFolder = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'dermiassist-node-runtime'; $runtime = Get-ChildItem $runtimeFolder -Filter node.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; $prefix = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'dermiassist-history-test-deps'; $env:NODE_PATH = Join-Path $prefix 'node_modules'; & $runtime --test --test-name-pattern='patient history' tests/production-regressions.test.cjs; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Verify history integration
tasks.command: $runtimeFolder = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'dermiassist-node-runtime'; $runtime = Get-ChildItem $runtimeFolder -Filter node.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; & $runtime --test tests/production-regressions.test.cjs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $runtime node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --incremental false; exit $LASTEXITCODE
